main_argument_chains.claim: The report count can be forecast by combining the two models.
support_steps: The raw series fails the ADF test and passes after one difference.
Each model is weighted by the other's mean squared error.
The bootstrap supplies the standard deviation.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: March 1, 2023 is given a point near 19944 and a 95 percent interval.

main_argument_chains.claim: Only two word attributes move the hard-mode share.
support_steps: Seven attributes are defined and three of them coded.
The model passes at the 10 percent level.
Only the initial letter and the word internal distance pass.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: The share falls by 0.618 from vowel to consonant and rises by 0.017 per unit of distance.

main_argument_chains.claim: The try shares are component data and have to be transformed.
support_steps: The seven shares sum to about 100 percent.
The shares are mapped onto a hypersphere.
The prediction is inverted before it is reported.
main_argument_chains.decision_consequence: EERIE is given seven shares and an uncertainty near 0.4.
